# homeassistant_entity (Data Source)

Reads the current state and attributes of one entity (`GET /api/states/<entity_id>`). The entity must exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "homeassistant_entity" "sun" {
  entity_id = "sun.sun"
}

output "sun_state" {
  value = data.homeassistant_entity.sun.state
}

# Attributes keep their JSON types, so numbers can be compared directly.
output "sun_is_high" {
  value = data.homeassistant_entity.sun.attributes.elevation > 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_id` (String) Entity ID, e.g. `sun.sun`.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (Dynamic) All attributes, as an object that keeps their JSON types: numbers stay numbers and booleans stay booleans.
- `device_class` (String) The `device_class` attribute, or null if the entity has none.
- `friendly_name` (String) The `friendly_name` attribute, or null if the entity has none.
- `last_changed` (String) When the state last changed, in ISO 8601.
- `last_updated` (String) When the state or attributes last changed, in ISO 8601.
- `state` (String) Current state, e.g. `on` or `21.5`.
- `unit_of_measurement` (String) The `unit_of_measurement` attribute, or null if the entity has none.
